referenceInfo.title: Scoring Guide
referenceInfo.p1: Dual-slope formula: male ≤72 kg → peakKg × 1.4 × W_factor; >72 kg → (100.8 + (peakKg − 72) × 0.775) × W_factor. Female ≤45 kg → peakKg × 2.24 × W_factor; >45 kg → (100.8 + (peakKg − 45) × 1.526) × W_factor. Dual golden anchors: male 75 kg, female 55 kg. If weight ≤ anchor, W_factor = (anchor ÷ weight)^0.5; if weight > anchor, W_factor = (anchor ÷ weight)^0.33. One decimal, then clamped 0–200.
referenceInfo.p2: Sex-specific model caps: male 200 kg, female 110 kg. Inputs above cap clamp for scoring and storage so world-record grips land ~175–183 pts and the ceiling closes at 200.
referenceInfo.p3: Source authority: norm distribution and ceiling reference IronMind Captains of Crush (CoC) elite-qualifier data, cross-checked against World's Strongest Man (WSM) historical record literature.
referenceInfo.p4: Benchmark inspiration draws from Magnus Samuelsson (1998 WSM champion; legendary certified closer of CoC No.4). To fully encompass contemporary elite records (including 175 kg+ world records), the model ceiling extends to 200 kg for males and 110 kg for females, anchoring at the maximum 200-point ceiling.
referenceInfo.p5: Product measurement guardrail — not a competition certification.
referenceInfo.p6: Scientific calibration: allometric scaling per square–cube physiology, with a gentler elite slope above the century gate so the grip axis closes at SCORE_AXIS_MAX (200). Female track uses a 55 kg anchor and 110 kg peak ceiling to avoid double inflation from the male anchor.
referenceInfo.p7: Balance checkpoints: male 100-point gate — 75 kg BW / 72 kg peak ≈ 100.8 pts; female 100-point gate — 55 kg BW / 45 kg peak ≈ 100.8 pts. World-record ~178 kg ≈ 183 pts; male 200 kg / female 110 kg close at 200. Lighter athletes gain relative-strength boost; super-heavy frames keep LEGEND (150+) / PANTHEON (160+) aura with inflation damped.
referenceInfo.p8: Changing Home body weight will dynamically recalculate your grip axis score from the latest weight.
